The amendment text (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H4000/409/House/Content) would require each voter to show valid State or Federal photo identification before receiving a ballot, list acceptable IDs (driver's license, passport, military ID, firearm ID card, other government photo ID), direct the Secretary of the Commonwealth to give a free photo ID to a registered voter without one who signs an affidavit, and take effect January 1, 2026.
